name: EPIC 210866350
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 4, 12.7 solar radii and 1.18 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 210866350 (K2 campaign 4): PARAM radius (solar radii) 12.733322 (16th-84th percentiles 12.229942-13.492973), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 210866350: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4880.695 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 210866350 (K2 campaign 4): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 3449.921875 (16th-84th percentiles 3368.28125-3537.226562), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 3,450 parsecs away, 13 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 4, give 1.18 solar masses and 12.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,881 K at its surface.
